trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL RETURN p.position AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL AND (p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] OR p.position IN ['Center', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'Forward', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'Guard']) WITH CASE WHEN p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Center', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'Forward'] THEN 'Frontcourt' WHEN p.position IN ['Backcourt', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'Guard'] THEN 'Backcourt' END AS position, CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS medals WHERE position IS NOT NULL RETURN position AS col1, MIN(medals) AS col2
